annotation.title_clean: Guidelines on the exemption procedure for the EU approval of automated vehicles
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on the exemption procedure for the EU approval of automated vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Internal Market, Industry, Entrepreneurship and SMEs
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page describing guidelines, endorsed by the TCMV on 12 February 2019, for national ad-hoc safety assessments and EU exemptions for SAE level 3 and 4 automated vehicles. They cover driving-mode behaviour, driver interaction, data recorders, cybersecurity, testing and user information, aiming to coordinate approvals across member states.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines coordinate national ad-hoc safety assessments for EU exemptions for automated vehicles.
Scope covers SAE level 3 and 4 vehicles.
Topics: automated mode behaviour, driver interaction, event data recorders, cybersecurity, testing, user information.
Endorsed by TCMV on 12 February 2019; EU countries expected to follow them.
Guidelines to be revised within a year; follows 2018 communication on connected and automated mobility.
